sobre.texto: CETADP, the Piracicaba Assemblies of God Theological Education Center, is dedicated to training members, workers, and leaders for ministry grounded in solid biblical and theological foundations. The CETADP Online Portal brings enrollment, registration, and student progress together in one place — from first contact through course completion.

cta.texto: Sign up in just a few minutes and your enrollment is confirmed instantly.
